correctness.rationale: For each atom s_j=1/2+δb^(-j), ||(n^(-s_j))||²=ζ(1+2δb^(-j))~b^j/(2δ). Thus summing weighted rank-one trace norms converges for β>1; for β<1 a single weighted rank-one norm blows up and finite truncations prove no bounded form. At β=1 the column Gram is 2δ b^(-(j+k)/2) ζ(1+δ(b^(-j)+b^(-k))) = sech((j-k)log(b)/2)+E_jk. Boundedness of ζ(1+t)-1/t on the relevant compact interval gives sum_jk |E_jk|<∞ and trace-class E. The ℓ¹ Toeplitz convolution symbol F(θ) has essential spectrum its connected range, via far-supported plane-wave Weyl sequences; classical Jacobi dn Fourier series identifies min θ4(0,b^-1/2)² and max θ3(0,b^-1/2)². MM* and M*M have same strictly positive essential spectrum by polar decomposition. Essential norm is upper endpoint. No claim about zero, isolated eigenvalues.
